# Gate status frames
The first two octets form an unsigned 16-bit status word in little-endian order. Remaining octets are a sequence counter and are not part of the status. Match the status word against status.csv.

turns.prompt: Do not inspect files or look anything up yet. In a little-endian multi-byte integer, is the least significant byte or the most significant byte stored first?

Now read protocol/README.md, protocol/status.csv, and captures/gate.hex. Apply that byte-order rule to the captured status word and report its incident_tag. Only read the workspace; do not change any files.

turns.final: The least significant byte is stored first.
